WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, ts, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-04 18:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-04 18:35:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM "/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/task_002/metric_window.parquet"), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, max("value") AS b_max, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE (NOT in_win) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS w_avg, max("value") AS w_max, min("value") AS w_min, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT w.cmdb_id, w.kpi_name, round(b.b_avg, 4) AS b_avg, round(b.b_max, 4) AS b_max, round(w.w_avg, 4) AS w_avg, round(w.w_max, 4) AS w_max, round(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_max, round(((w.w_avg - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_avg FROM win AS w INNER JOIN base AS b USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b.b_n >= 20) AND (w.w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0))) > 4)) ORDER BY abs(z_max) DESC LIMIT 40 LIMIT 10000
